SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION FIXTURE. Not a real manufacturer manual.
Training pump P-01 maintenance manual, revision B.
Applicability: synthetic training pump P-01 only.
The maximum continuous housing temperature is 80 degrees Celsius.
This limit supersedes revision A, which listed 100 degrees Celsius.
A housing temperature reading below this limit alone does not establish safe operation or diagnose a fault.
Record measurement location, timestamp and operating conditions before comparison.
